situation: Two sisters who both follow the same true crime podcast.
topic: Talking through the gruesome forensic details of an invented serial killer case, the injuries to the victims, the killer's psychology, and whether they find it disturbing or fascinating.

text: Ok so ep 6 I cant stop thinking about the lake
the bit with the shoes?
Yeah. He always leaves them in a pair on the bank
that's so creepy why would u do that
Thats kind of my theory tho. I think he keeps going back to the same spot bc its where he first felt in control. Like the lake is where he got to decide
hmm ok that's actually good. or he just can't let go of it
Same thing maybe? The going back is the bit that gets me. Not the injuries so much
the injuries are still bad tho the coroner bit in ep 4 I had to pause
Yeah that was grim. Dont want to be that person who says its fascinating but I do find the psychology interesting
you're not that person 😂 i'm the same. disturbing AND can't stop
anyway mum sunday. did u sort the cake
Not yet. I was going to get the lemon one from the place on london rd
she said last year she doesnt like lemon
She said she doesnt like the frosting on lemon. Thats different
ok fine. i'll get flowers, u get cake. not the lemon
Deal. And card is me obviously, u always forget the card
Sorry was on the phone with a client for ages, they cant find invoices for the whole of q3
oof. that's ur whole weekend gone
also did u listen to the bit where they found the second body
Not yet. Saving it for when im in bed 😬 no I dont want to be scared
lol ur such a baby. i've listened to it 3 times already
no judgement, its a really well made ep
Ok. Listened. The bit with the dog walker is awful
RIGHT and then the detective says the thing about the tide
I think he dumps them where the tide wont reach. Thats the same as the theory. He wants them where he can get back to
ok now ur freaking me out go to bed
I'm not going to bed for an hour lol
mum just sent me a link to a cardigan she wants for sunday
She wants a cardigan or she wants u to buy her the cardigan
the second one. the cardigan is £140
Ok ill pay half. Dont tell her
Night. Dont dream about the lake
did u actually sleep or r u still thinking about the lake
Slept fine. Dreamt about a spreadsheet which is worse
that's basically accountancy
client rang me about the lease thing again. third time this month. they want me to ring the landlord AND his brother who is the other landlord
Ugh. Are you getting paid for each call or is it just them being like that
they're like that
Going with chocolate for mum. Not lemon, not frosting on lemon, not anything fancy. Just chocolate
ok. that's safe
about the cardigan. i'm not paying 140 for it
Its half each. I said I'd pay half. Ill send u 70 tonight if u order it
she's going to know it was us
it's the same colour as the one she had in 2019 and gave to the charity shop
She wont know. Shes not going to check the label
ep 7 is up. dont listen alone
Im not listening to it this week. Got the Q3 thing still
the client sorted their invoices??
Found 2 of 40. The rest are in a box in a garage apparently
that's a horror ep honestly
ok i listened. not the lake bit. the bit about the bus station
Don't tell me
i'm not going to tell u. i'm just saying there's a bus station bit
Night
did u send the 70 or not
Sending now. Go to sleep
ordered. she's getting it wrapped in tissue like we're a shop
Ta. Did it say the right size
it said medium. mum's a 12. i checked twice
Medium is fine. She'll say it's too big and wear it every day
Client found 31 of 40 invoices. Garage box is still a mystery
ur a hero
the landlord rang ME this morning. not the client. he wanted to know if i was the one who sent the letter
i said yes obviously
Did the brother ring too
yes. they agreed on one thing which is that i'm the problem
Sounds like a Christmas dinner
don't. i'm already dreading it
walked past the cake place on london rd on my way back. the lemon ones are in the window. don't look
I'm not looking
Chocolate's booked. Ordered for 11 Sunday
ok. wait is 11 too early for a lunch
It's a lunch, not a breakfast. And she's always wanted to eat at 12
fine. 11 cake, 12 lunch. i'll be there at 11:55 like always
Ep 7 tonight or are we pretending we're not doing it
i'm not doing it on my own. u have to be in it with me
Tomorrow. I'll listen on the bus
ur not on a bus, u drive everywhere
Fine. Lunch break
just got back from the gym and the bus station bit is still in my head. i swear the guy in ep 7 is the same guy who was stood outside the interchange on monday
Abi no
it was a man in a grey coat who kept looking at his phone. you don't know.
Almost everyone at a bus station is in a grey coat looking at their phone. That's what bus stations are
ok ok. night. lock the door
I always lock the door. Night
